title: Lesson 18 - Getting Data In: Streams, DMO Mapping and File Eligibility
description: Explain the considerations of Agentforce Data Library and its concepts.

questions.question: Which object references your unstructured files without copying them into Salesforce?
questions.explanation: A UDLO references unstructured data in an external blob store and holds its metadata, while the DMO is the modeled shape and the data stream is the connection that ingests structured data.

questions.question: Chunking for a new Knowledge based library is taking much longer than expected. Which factor most directly explains the duration?
options: The number of data spaces in the org.
The number of permission sets assigned to agents.
The number, size and complexity of articles or files and the number of knowledge fields selected for chunking.
The version of the large language model behind the agent.
questions.explanation: Chunking time scales with the volume and complexity of the content and the number of knowledge fields you selected, not with org licensing or model version.

questions.question: Which data library source creates a retriever but no search index?
questions.explanation: A web search library is read-only and fetches content live, so it creates only a retriever and skips the chunk-and-index chain.
